images.prompt: Create a new wide 16:9 editorial product illustration for the Widgets section of Halcyon's GitHub README. The first reference is the approved cover: its luminous sculptural indigo kingfisher feathers and violet-gold rim lighting, charcoal night palette, sharply legible typography and generous spacing are the visual language. Do not reproduce its title, logo or composition. The other references supply actual widget shapes, controls, and data. Build an intentional, near-frontal studio still life of THREE functional desktop widgets on a near-black graphite field. Make a substantial smoked-glass Music player the clear foreground focal point across the lower left/center, roughly 62% of the width, square cover art of a violet dusk reflected in a lake, a soft violet glow physically localized around the cover, clearly typeset 'Blue Hour' and 'Mira', simple previous / pause / next playback icons and a slender lavender progress line. Above right, a smaller complete Weather widget with a beautiful moonlit alpine sky illustration integrated into its own face, one partly cloudy icon and generous, legible '18°', 'Zagreb', 'Partly cloudy'. Lower right, a significantly smaller dark Focus tile with a quiet mint ring and '18:42' inside. Keep the three functional faces completely readable, entirely inside the frame with 5% perimeter breathing room; avoid hiding one widget behind another. The large music and smaller secondary widgets form a balanced asymmetrical editorial composition, not a regular dashboard or proof grid. The support/background is very dark graphite with a single softly defocused sweep of the hero's cobalt-violet feather grazing the margins behind the composition, one subtle warm reflection. Thin intermittent optical glints, highly transparent smoked glass where true to the widget, tidy typography and restrained shadows. Native COSMIC-like minimal controls. No external labels, title, captions, feature slogans, page chrome, prices, spreadsheets, devices, logos or floating decorative icons. Crisp visually rich professional software launch artwork that reads on GitHub at 728 pixels wide; landscape edge to edge.

Create a wide 16:9 premium product illustration for Halcyon’s README feature on crystal widget glass. First reference gives the visual language: a dramatic folded blue-violet luminous kingfisher feather, gold at the extreme edge, deep near-black navy negative space, meticulous art direction. The second is the shipped Messages widget and actual Crystal and Frosted optical reference. Design a macro, near-frontal close-up of ONE large, functional transparent smoked Crystal Messages widget (rounded rectangle with shallow radius) centered slightly left, about 61% of frame width and 69% of its height; visible full silhouette. The underlying wallpaper is a sculptural blue-violet feather sweeping up from the lower left to right on an indigo graphite field. One very clear softly luminous lilac/gold diagonal feather edge crosses *behind the pane*, remains legible through its dark transparent face, bends subtly as it crosses the rounded glass perimeter, then continues outside in the same direction. This precise bend in a continuous wallpaper contour is the unmistakable focal detail. Large readable restrained COSMIC-like Messages contents with header 'Messages' at left and '2 unread' at right, then exactly three natural rows, each has a quiet circular initial, a sender name and a single short line: 'Sam Rivera' / 'Save me a seat', 'Mum' / 'Call me when you’re home', 'Alex Chen' / 'See you Friday'. Small muted timestamps if space allows. Show real material through fine directional highlights in two corners, selective thin cool specular edges and variable refraction. Leave much of the rim dark; no thick white strokes, stacked borders or exaggerated physical thickness. Crisp clean text in ivory, muted lavender accents, warm light kissing one corner, restrained soft shadows. The luminous wallpaper must feel related to the hero but this is a new composition, no hero title, no Halcyon logo, no slogan, no explanatory captions, no dock, no extra widgets, no diagram, no split comparison, no generic dashboard, no physical monitor or product photography props. High detail in the optics and feather surface, simple silhouettes and plenty of quiet area. Professional software launch artwork, beautiful at 728px wide.
